mapper.select: SELECT m.MEMBER_NO, n.MEMBER_ID, n.MEMBER_PWD, m.ROLE, m.DEL_YN FROM WELLNESS_MEMBER m JOIN WELLNESS_NORMAL_MEMBER n ON m.MEMBER_NO = n.MEMBER_NO WHERE m.DEL_YN = 'N' AND n.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
